reason_not_executed: Released B0/B1 heads are not in this checkout, so validation relight maps were not computed and no FPR is claimed.
downsample: adaptive_avg_pool2d to (k, k), PyTorch integer cell bounds floor(i*H/k) and ceil((i+1)*H/k)
boundary: bilinear samples are clamped inside the coarse grid; nothing is read outside it
threshold: higher empirical quantile of corrected regular-light normal validation image scores at 1 - 0.05; released scores and thresholds are not written
std_scope: per category, seed and B0/B1 run; population standard deviation of all residual patches
selection_rule: a size is eligible only if every run passes the std floor; minimize the worst absolute relight FPR gap from 0.05; tie keeps the smaller k

spatial_maps.clip: clip(image * gain, 0, 1), with no extra gamma

identity_rule: exactly eight categories, seeds 0-2, and arms B0 and B1; a partial matrix is rejected
